name: Vizcom
summary: Product design tool that turns sketches into photorealistic renders and 3D models.
description: Vizcom is built for industrial, footwear, apparel, automotive and gaming designers. It turns sketches into photorealistic renders and 3D models and supports team collaboration. The Starter plan is free; Professional costs $49 per user per month; Enterprise is quoted on request. Qualified students and educators can use an Education plan for free. Paid plans include monthly rendering credits: 800 on Starter and 20,000 on Professional.

howToUse.title: Open Vizcom
howToUse.description: Open Vizcom, built for designers in industrial, footwear, apparel, automotive, and gaming work. Starter is free and includes 800 monthly rendering credits.

howToUse.title: Turn sketches into renders
howToUse.description: Add sketches, describe the form and materials, and Vizcom turns them into photorealistic renders and also builds 3D models.

howToUse.title: Iterate with the team
howToUse.description: Vary the form and color, try a new view, then use the team collaboration Vizcom supports.

howToUse.title: Match the plan to the studio
howToUse.description: Professional costs $49 per user a month and includes 20,000 rendering credits. Enterprise is quoted on request. Qualified students and educators can use the Education plan for free.
